newsitem.title: USA: Agouron unit seeks European OK for Viracept.
newsitem.headline: Agouron unit seeks European OK for Viracept.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc on Wednesday said its European unit has applied to regulators to sell its anti-HIV drug Viracept in Europe.
The filing, called a marketing authorization application, was made to the European Medicines Evaluation Agency, the company said in a statement.

Viracept, or nelfinavir mesylate, is one of a new class of HIV protease inhibitors that is being produced by Agouron and Japan Tobacco Inc. The European application seeks approval for the drug in tablet and pediatric oral powder forms.
Action by the European regulatory board is expected later in calendar 1997. A new drug application for Viracept was filed in the United States on December 23, 1996.
